description: Fires whenever a new deal is saved to KV. Make.com appends the deal to the Master Log Google Sheet, updates rep individual sheets, logs to Setter KPI sheet, and sends a payout-ready notification to the team Discord.

payload.id: string — unique deal ID (e.g. 'stripe-cs_xxx' or UUID)
payload.clientName: string — full name of the client
payload.dmSetter: string | null — DM setter's name if applicable
payload.setter: string | null — setter's name if applicable
payload.closer: string | null — closer's name if applicable

payouts.totalPayouts: number — sum of all rep cuts

makeSteps: Step 1: Receive webhook — parse deal payload
Step 2: Append row to Master Log Google Sheet (Deal Log tab, columns A:S)
Step 3: Append/update setter row in Setter KPI Daily Log sheet
Step 4: Append row to each involved rep's personal Google Sheet
Step 5: Send Discord notification to DISCORD_WEBHOOK_DEAL_CLOSED channel
Step 6: (Optional) Trigger payout calculation reminder if week total exceeds threshold
